site: Cargill careers posting, application link to Paradox
class: Unscoped posting fields and descendant-text matches confused auxiliary widgets with application progress
symptom: Senior Network Security Engineer - SASE paused on its posting with a generic stopped-before-last-page message; Apply Now produced a submission-guard denial.
root_cause: on_job_description counted search and talent-community fields across the entire page. is_review_step_by_wizard_marker matched Review anywhere below any element with active in its class, including a search form with a hidden option. This prevented the guarded GET application-entry path, and the resulting Apply click was correctly blocked by containment.
why_tests_missed: Posting fixtures had few fields and review fixtures contained real short wizard labels; no tests combined a main posting, auxiliary forms, hidden Review options, and an armed submission guard.
fix: Scope posting field counts to a unique visible main landmark only when it offers an Apply anchor outside a form; retain application-field and already-filled checks. Require visible review controls and exact visible review-marker text. Verify entry GET followed by blocked final submission. Exclude explicitly identified talent-community subscription forms inside main only when they have no mixed application actions, password fields, or upload fields.
prevention: Test auxiliary widgets and hidden templates alongside the real application region; observe navigation and guard outcomes rather than treating a planner label or generic handoff as evidence of the current step.
